speedRangeMph.note: CORRECTED after direct extraction (initial recon guessed 9 rows including 60 -- wrong). Table 302-02 genuinely has only 8 rows, skipping 60 mph entirely (25,30,35,40,45,50,55,65) -- the same gap pattern as 619-011.json's tables['011-03'] (buffer-only table), even though 619-011's own tables['011-02'] (the master taper table) DOES have a 60mph row. Verified twice: word-grouping extraction with assert_row_count, and a page-wide search for any '60' token in the table's y-band, both independently confirming no 60mph row. knownAnomalies.issue: CROSS-SHEET DISCREPANCY, not a transcription error: this sheet prints 800/20/21 for this cell (20 skip lines x 40 ft = 800 -- internally consistent, devices=21=skips+1). Data/sheet-specs/619-011.json's master table 011-02 prints 800/19/20 for the SAME lookup (45mph... no, same speed/lateral-shift combination) -- which 011-02's own knownAnomalies entry already flags as internally INCONSISTENT (19*40=760, not 800). Verified directly against this sheet's own PDF vector text twice before accepting -- 619-302's value is correct per the ft=skipLines*40 rule; 619-011's is the one with a printing defect. Two different official NYSDOT sheets disagree on this cell. Transcribed as printed on THIS sheet per the verbatim rule; do not silently reconcile the two sheets to match each other.
knownAnomalies.recommendation: Prefer this sheet's own value (800/20/21) when resolving 619-302; do not average or defer to 619-011's figure for this specific cell.

303A.title: DETAIL 303A
303A.note: Referenced by Note 6 (transverse channelizing when shoulder >= 8' closed > 800'). Spotter also shown.

printed: 1. SHORT-TERM STATIONARY IS DAYTIME WORK THAT OCCUPIES A LOCATION FOR MORE THAN 1 HOUR WITHIN A SINGLE DAYLIGHT PERIOD.
2. IN URBAN CONDITIONS, ADVANCE WARNING SIGN SPACINGS MAY BE ADJUSTED IN ORDER TO ACCOMMODATE SIDE STREETS AND DRIVEWAYS. IF THERE IS A CONFLICT, MOVE THE SIGN UPSTREAM.
3. THERE SHALL BE NO WORKERS, EQUIPMENT OR OTHER VEHICLES IN THE BUFFER SPACE OR THE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE.

4. THE PROTECTIVE VEHICLE(S) SHALL MAINTAIN THE APPROPRIATE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE, BE AN UNOCCUPIED TRUCK POSITIONED PARALLEL TO TRAFFIC, PARKING BRAKE SET, PLACED IN 2ND GEAR (MANUAL TRANSMISSIONS /ENGINE OFF) OR PARK / NEUTRAL (AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS) AND HAVE THE FRONT WHEELS ALIGNED WITH THE LANE STRIPING.
5. LEFT LANE CLOSURES ARE SYMMETRICAL TO RIGHT LANE CLOSURES. SUBSTITUTE THE W20-5a SIGN AND THE CORRESPONDING W4-2 SIGN.
6. CHANNELIZING DEVICES SHALL BE PLACED TRANSVERSELY A MINIMUM OF EVERY 800' AS SHOWN WHEN A PAVED SHOULDER HAVING A WIDTH OF 8' OR GREATER IS CLOSED FOR A DISTANCE GREATER THAN 800'.
7. CHANNELIZING DEVICE SPACING (CENTER TO CENTER) SHALL NOT EXCEED 40' IN THE ACTIVE WORK SPACE.
8. THE MINIMUM LANE WIDTH SHALL BE 11' FOR FREEWAYS AND 10' FOR NON-FREEWAYS.
9. VEH #2 IS ONLY NEEDED WHEN THE SHOULDER WIDTH IS >= 8'.
